They were led by 10th-year head coach [[Lon Kruger]] and played their home games at the [[Lloyd Noble Center]] in [[Norman, Oklahoma|Norman]], [[Oklahoma]], as members of the [[Big 12 Conference]]. They finished the season 16–11, 9–8 in [[2020–21 Big 12 Conference men's basketball season|Big 12 play]] to finish in a tie for sixth place. As the No. 7 seed in the [[2021 Big 12 men's basketball tournament|Big 12 tournament]], they defeated [[2020–21 Iowa State Cyclones men's basketball team|Iowa State]] before losing to [[2020–21 Kansas Jayhawks men's basketball team|Kansas]] in the quarterfinals. They received an at-large bid to the [[2021 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] as the No. 8 seed in the West region. There they defeated [[2020–21 Missouri Tigers men's basketball team|Missouri]] in the First Round before losing to [[2020–21 Gonzaga Bulldogs men's basketball team|Gonzaga]] in the Second Round. On March 25, 2021, head coach Lon Kruger retired as head coach after 10 years at Oklahoma and 45 years of coaching.{{Cite web|date=2021-03-25|title=Oklahoma's Kruger retires after 45-year career|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/31135165/oklahoma-sooners-men-basketball-coach-lon-kruger-retiring-45-years-coaching|access-date=2021-04-07|website=ESPN.com|language=en}} On April 3, the school named [[Loyola Ramblers men's basketball|Loyola]] coach [[Porter Moser]] the new head coach.{{Cite web|title=Oklahoma hires Loyola Chicago's Porter Moser to replace Lon Kruger as Sooners coach|url=https://www.cbssports.com/college-basketball/news/oklahoma-hires-loyola-chicagos-porter-moser-to-replace-lon-kruger-as-sooners-coach/|access-date=2021-04-07|website=CBSSports.com|language=en}} ==Previous season== The [[2019–20 Oklahoma Sooners men's basketball team|Sooners]] finished the [[2019-20 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2019–20 season]] with an overall record of 19–11, 9–9 in [[2019–20 Big 12 Conference men's basketball season|Big 12 play]] to finish in a tie for third place.
